title: La Sportiva Lavaredo Ultra Trail by UTMB — official homepage
publisher: La Sportiva Lavaredo Ultra Trail by UTMB
claims: The homepage's About the race section states: 'Born in 2007, La Sportiva Lavaredo Ultra Trail by UTMB® is the dream of all trail runners.'

The same section says the event takes place 'in one of the most evocative landscapes of the UNESCO World Heritage Dolomites, Cortina d'Ampezzo', and that it offers 5 race distances led by the Lavaredo 120K with 5,800 m of elevation gain.

verification.note: 2026-11-09 直取 https://lavaredo.utmb.world/ 首页 About the race 段。首页页头日期仍写 24-28 June 2026，与 2027 赛事页不一致；本来源只引定位原句，不把首页日期当作 2027 届信息。页面无发布日，accessedAt 为读取日。

claimVerification.note: 原文：'Born in 2007, La Sportiva Lavaredo Ultra Trail by UTMB® is the dream of all trail runners.'

原文：'It takes place in one of the most evocative landscapes of the UNESCO World Heritage Dolomites, Cortina d’Ampezzo, which in 2026 will host the Winter Olympics. The event offers 5 race distances, the most important of which is the Lavaredo 120K, with an elevation gain of 5,800 metres.'
